description: Add an alert rule for the signed-in clipper, or change one with rule_id. For example, 'tell me about YouTube campaigns on Clipster over $2 per 1K' is platforms youtube, boards clipster, min_rate_per_1k_usd 2. A rule matches new campaigns by minimum pay per 1K views (in $0.50 steps), platforms, niches, boards, pay type, lowest Alpha tier and open join. Alerts arrive on the clipper's channels within their daily cap and quiet hours. Needs the clipper's ClippingAlpha sign-in. Changes only their own rules.

min_rate_per_1k_usd.description: Minimum pay per 1,000 views in USD, rounded down to $0.50 steps. 0 for any.

min_tier.description: Lowest Alpha tier to alert on.

niches.description: Content niches. Empty for every niche.

open_join_only.description: Only campaigns anyone can join with no application.

pay_type.description: per_view pays per 1K views (the default), per_post pays a flat amount a post, any takes both.

platforms.description: Platforms the clipper posts on. Empty for every platform.

rule_id.description: Change this rule. Leave out to add a new one.

name: set_alert_rule
title: Set an alert rule
